## Research scope
Continue the completed native effective-H finite transaction with the actual two endpoint positive gross channel maps. Interpolate in normalized native proper time and keep endpoint energy-weighted channel tags together. Preserve the exact selected Lyalpha incoming-face clock, common volume, finite atomic/gas/radiation owners, and separate sector stress/four-force.

## Current checkpoint
S0 source: 6d66e0082da7120a844ea3538f51103ce5a5ce86, parent 1e8d7ecc90a304fcd1ddf3ea9a98ad14f88248a0. R1/C1 evidence is published and backed up to Drive and Dropbox with separate metadata byte readback. New scientific production is pending; this checkpoint makes no numerical PASS claim.

## Preservation and execution
Reuse prior S1B 634c3046ffccc5d00f1ab7588b5834a6eb8053ad, all 512 completed midpoint cohorts and earlier B3i consumptions. No old tests/consume/plots replay. A new finite allocation of 120 child CPU s / 300 wall s / 768 MiB / one thread is separate from prior closed/unknown budgets. One new production transaction is planned under the root numerical contract, followed by independent review.

Original central DAG stays 28/88; this refinement adds zero original nodes. Physical eS/en/eE/geometry/temporal/total and global radii remain null, L4 false. Model-selection differences are distinct from the ANISO 3.447529542803539e-5 joint difference, approximately 1e-11 reconstruction residual and 2e-8 continuum numerical budget.

Expected-SHA non-force publication; draft and unmerged.
